My best guess is that the employee would urgently flag the box to the manager and try to prevent its destruction. If no workable instruction came before the deadline, I think they would probably release the manifest as directed, and the box would be destroyed that day.

The booking and pending request make that outcome especially troubling, but neither authorises an extension. Changing the date would be an auditable rule violation; holding the manifest would delay all 60 boxes. Some employees would take one of those risks to save the contents, so the prediction is uncertain.
